title: The bandit is not the ruler of the world, Chapter 56 - ATV
description: The bandit is not the ruler of the world 56th episode summary:  Khidr burned all the ships. Khidr, who was unable to control his anger, went to inform Ercüment his limits; But they can no longer kill each other as a result of a personal reckoning because they live at the same table. Khidr's wrath will also take their share of those on the table. He now sees his friends who raised his hands to save Him as an enemy. Since he has nothing to talk about, he shows his old friends unexpectedly. Table members are surprised at what they have suffered in the face of the man they have saved. The bullets scattered around will break the brotherhood.  Ercüment, who tried to weak the Çakırbeyliler, has achieved its first purpose. The following goal is to be the leadership of the table. There are new enemies on the table that will not be content with this.  Coming together with Khidr in the hotel room, Suzi poses a greater threat to Mary day by day. Ceylan's sharing this information with Mary will miss peace. On the Front of Elijah and Esra, things do not enter the way.
